title: How AMCs run a step-up
objectives: Give the SBI and DSP terms as examples.
Explain why a step-up may mean cancelling and re-registering an existing SIP.
body_md:
Terms differ by AMC and platform, so always check the scheme's form. Two examples show how much they vary.

## SBI Mutual Fund

Top-up of at least ₹500, in multiples of ₹500; half-yearly or yearly for monthly SIPs; chosen at enrolment.

## DSP Mutual Fund

Fixed (minimum ₹500) or percentage top-up; half-yearly or yearly; the instalment is capped at ₹5 lakh or the bank mandate limit, whichever is lower.

## Two practical points

- A step-up is often available only on a fresh SIP, so converting an existing SIP may mean cancelling it and registering a new one.
- The bank mandate must be large enough for the future, higher instalments.

## What to check on the form

The minimum and multiple, the frequency allowed, whether a cap is available, and whether the facility can be added to an existing registration.
example: A client's 4-year-old SIP has no step-up facility. Converting it means cancelling and re-registering, which resets the instalment clock and can change the exit-load terms. A second, smaller SIP is often the cleaner route.
say: Let's check the scheme form for the minimum and frequency before we set the step-up.
The bank mandate has to cover the highest future instalment, not today's.
never: All AMCs run step-ups the same way.
The mandate will adjust itself as the SIP grows.

talk_track.title: Terms differ by AMC: always check the form
talk_track.text: How fund houses run step-ups differs, so always check the scheme's form. At SBI Mutual Fund, the top-up is at least five hundred rupees, in multiples of five hundred; it can be half-yearly or yearly for monthly SIPs, and it's chosen at enrolment. At DSP Mutual Fund, the top-up can be a fixed amount from five hundred rupees, or a percentage; it's half-yearly or yearly; and the instalment is capped at five lakh rupees or the bank mandate limit. A step-up is often available only on a fresh SIP.

check.q: What is the SBI Mutual Fund top-up minimum?
check.why: At least ₹500, in multiples of ₹500, half-yearly or yearly for monthly SIPs, chosen at enrolment.

check.q: At DSP Mutual Fund, the instalment under a step-up is capped at…
o: ₹5 lakh or the bank mandate limit, whichever is lower
check.why: The instalment is capped at ₹5 lakh or the mandate limit, whichever is lower.

check.q: Why might converting an existing SIP mean re-registering it?
o: Because the AMC changes its name
Because a step-up is often available only on a fresh SIP
Because the exit load changes every year
Because SEBI requires a new KYC
